name: AgentReader
about: The art director's own sculpt of the agent piece for release 2 (agent-piece-r2.obj, from her scripts figs.py, spy3d.py and sheet.py), turned into the game's model file by Tools/obj_to_model.py. One unit is the figure, from the base's top to the hat's crown. A faceless figure in a trench coat and fedora, reading an open newspaper held at the height of his face, on a brass-rimmed base. No lantern.
